summary: NewGenIvf Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, announcing an additional share purchase agreement with PredicXion Group Limited (K25.ai) to acquire a further 4% equity interest for $4 million consideration, comprising $1.9 million in cash or digital assets and 1.5 million newly issued Class A ordinary shares. This increases NewGenIvf's aggregate stake to 10%, implying a $100 million valuation for PredicXion. A $100,000 cash deposit is due at signing, with the balance payable by September 30, 2026; $1.7 million from a prior SPA is also being settled. The shares issued are restricted under Regulation S. Closing is subject to customary conditions. Key watchpoints include funding of deferred consideration and integration of the minority investment.
